reason: A DSH Web settings-page plugin that provides a panel for viewing and enabling or disabling third-party plugins by updating profile patch configuration files.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 设置页中提供第三方插件列表，并支持通过修改配置文件启用或禁用插件。
summaries.en: Adds a DSH Web settings tab for viewing third-party plugins and enabling or disabling them through profile configuration changes.

capabilities: Adds a settings-page tab for listing third-party plugins
Reads profile bundle stacks and patch files
Writes disabled flags to profile cordis.patch.yml files
Exposes same-origin custom routes for listing and changing plugin state
Triggers client-side page reloads and relies on DSH hot reload for configuration changes
